# Method array seed with a fixed nominal result and contexts

An owned static method accepts its own Object-bounded formal array and closed
nominal contexts while retaining an opaque fixed String result. An original
delegation supplies null prefix/suffix contexts. Four frozen routes compare 96
cases twice with source and SDK providers, observing original array identity and
component type, callback mutation, ArrayStoreException, null/empty/bad arrays,
element/delimiter conversion order, partial writes and exact checked/runtime/error
objects. Every generated source and original metadata entry is compiled and
audited. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls guard the
proof. Only owned classes execute.
